,****
I’m editing the post to avoid misunderstandings after I was corrected.
At first, I understood that there might be a change starting in May regarding how these marriages are treated in Israel, but I’ve since learned that there is actually no change.
There was a legislative initiative in Utah itself to cancel remote marriages, but it was revised and ultimately did not pass, so everything remains the same****

Hi everyone! 

 I need some urgent clarification regarding Utah online marriages and the recent court decision in Israel.

My partner and I got married via Utah in April, but we have not yet received the apostilled marriage certificate. From what I understand, starting in May, these types of marriages may no longer be accepted by the Israeli immigration office.

1. Since our marriage took place in April (before the change), but we don’t yet have the apostille, will our marriage still be recognized when we submit it?

2. There is also the requirement to report a marriage within 30 days. How can I comply with this if my apostilled certificate hasn’t arrived yet? (to Israel) or I can submit the digital copy 

3. Should I proceed with reporting the marriage first, or is this a separate process from applying for an A5 visa/spousal status for my partner? 

I’d really appreciate guidance from anyone who has gone through a similar situation or has up-to-date information.

Thank you!

🩷
